lineage.description: Building footprints and attributes were extracted from OpenStreetMap, a volunteered geographic information platform. The Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team processed and exported the data in multiple formats, with AI-assisted analysis estimating approximately 71% completeness of the total building stock. Data quality metrics indicate an average age of 3 years with recent updates in the last 6 months.
